svg.text: Modular Component Architecture: Hardware Interfacing, STEP-SAFE Wi-Fi, Flask API, SQLite & Mobile Notifications

g.text: • DHCP Server for Mac & Mobile Clients
• Risk Classifier: NORMAL, PRESSURE, HIGH PRESSURE, HIGH RISK
• Escalates to HIGH RISK when Sustained Pressure + Elevated Temp
• Formats Alert Payloads & Dispatches to Notification Module

svg.text: Local monitoring works without internet (ESP32 ↔ Flask via STEP-SAFE Wi-Fi). Mobile push notifications require a separate internet connection on the MacBook/backend.
